business_summary: Universal Logistics Holdings, Inc. provides customized transportation and logistics solutions in the United States, Mexico, Canada, and Colombia. It operates through three segments: Contract Logistics, Intermodal, and Trucking. The Contract Logistics segment offers value-added and dedicated transportation services to support inbound logistics and industrial manufacturers and major retailers, including material handling, consolidation, sequencing, sub-assembly, cross-dock services, kitting, repacking, warehousing, returnable container management, and rail lift services. This segment also provides dedicated services which involve short-haul or round-trip moves within a defined geographic area provided through a network of union and non-union employee drivers, owner-operators, and contract drivers. The Intermodal segment offers local and regional drayage services through company-managed terminals using a combination of owner-operators, company equipment, and third-party capacity providers comprising steamship-truck, rail-truck, and support services. The Trucking segment engages in dry van, flatbed, heavy-haul and refrigerated operations for transporting various general commodities, such as automotive parts, machinery, building materials, paper, food, consumer goods, furniture, steel, other metals, and other industrial and consumer goods. The company is also involved in brokerage activities, as well as provision of support services. It serves automotive, retail and consumer goods, metals, and energy and manufacturing industries. The company was formerly known as Universal Truckload Services, Inc. and changed its name to Universal Logistics Holdings, Inc. in April 2016. Universal Logistics Holdings, Inc. was founded in 1981 and is headquartered in Warren, Michigan.
business_summary_ko: Universal Logistics Holdings, Inc.는 미국, 멕시코, 캐나다 및 콜롬비아에서 맞춤형 운송 및 물류 솔루션을 제공합니다. 계약 물류, 복합 운송 및 트럭 운송의 세 가지 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 계약 물류 부문은 자재 취급, 통합, 순서 지정, 하위 조립, 크로스 도크 서비스, 키팅, 재포장, 창고 보관, 반환 가능한 컨테이너 관리 및 레일 리프트 서비스를 포함하여 인바운드 물류 및 산업 제조업체와 주요 소매업체를 지원하는 부가가치 전용 운송 서비스를 제공합니다. 이 부문은 또한 조합 및 비조합 직원 운전자, 자영업자 및 계약 운전자 네트워크를 통해 제공되는 정의된 지리적 영역 내에서의 단거리 또는 왕복 이동을 포함하는 전용 서비스를 제공합니다. 복합 운송 부문은 자영업자, 회사 장비, 증기선 트럭, 철도 트럭 및 지원 서비스로 구성된 제3자 용량 공급자의 조합을 사용하여 회사 관리 터미널을 통해 현지 및 지역 운송 서비스를 제공합니다. 트럭 운송 부문은 다양한 일반 상품을 운송하기 위한 드라이 밴, 플랫베드, 중량 화물 운송 및 냉장 작업에 종사합니다.
